name: EPIC-Kitchens 2020 Object Detection Challenge
description: In this report, we describe the technical details of oursubmission to the EPIC-Kitchens Object Detection Challenge.Duck filling and mix-up techniques are firstly introduced to augment the data and significantly improve the robustness of the proposed method. Then we propose GRE-FPN and Hard IoU-imbalance Sampler methods to extract more representative global object features. To bridge the gap of category imbalance, Class Balance Sampling is utilized and greatly improves the test results. Besides, some training and testing strategies are also exploited, such as Stochastic Weight Averaging and multi-scale testing. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach can significantly improve the mean Average Precision (mAP) of object detection on both the seen and unseen test sets of EPICKitchens.
reputation: A challenge benchmark tied to the EPIC-Kitchens dataset and used in the egocentric vision community for object detection under realistic kitchen conditions.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; performance is reported on seen and unseen test sets, with strong class imbalance and domain-specific egocentric imagery.
